messages:
leo_finance: Kicking off a small pricing experiment for mid-tier credits + embedding micro-rate tweak. Target go-live 2026-05-03 09:00 UTC. Need invoice preview, grandfather rules, and sign-offs.

miguel_billing: Please define cohort filters (plan IDs / tags). Also request adding `rate_experiment_id` on invoice lines to simplify reconciliation.

rachel_sales: Exclude all customers with `negotiated` or `enterprise` tags. I'll pull AM-owned account list and flag anyone who needs manual outreach.

sophie_legal: I'll review contracts for any clauses preventing changes. Also draft comms copy with explicit "no retroactive charges" language. Will deliver by Tue EOD.

elana_ops: Staging SQL to validate cohort:
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-05-03' AND '2026-05-31'
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%'
  AND c.negotiated = false;
```
I'll push CSV to /finance-drive after run.

miguel_billing: Running invoice preview: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort mid-credit-v3 --sample 60`. Billing-bot will post results.

billing-bot: invoice-preview complete for cohort mid-credit-v3 60 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/mid-credit-v3-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Preview shows 7 subs with manual rate overrides and 3 with legacy promo credits. Propose marking overrides as `manual-grandfather` and issuing one-off credits for promo gaps. Need sign-off on credit calc method.

leo_finance: Approve manual-grandfather for overrides. Miguel, prepare exceptions sheet with proposed credit amounts and rationale; we'll review in preflight.

elana_ops: Ops tasks: update payments rate map (`mid_credit_v3` -> `RC_MID_V3`), submit PR for deploy, run migration dry-run: `make billing-migrate COHORT=mid-credit-v3 DRY_RUN=1`. Include rollback steps in PR.

rachel_sales: I'll coordinate AM notifications for accounts in CSV and hold a small batch outreach list. Sophie will you approve comms by Tue EOD?

sophie_legal: Yes. Posting legal-approved comms and FAQ by Tue noon. Will include opt-out pathway and support escalation flow.

leo_finance: Canary plan: 4% invoice volume first 24h -> 30% days 2-3 -> full at day 6 if stable. Rollback triggers: >4% revenue variance in 24h, >1% uptick in billing tickets, or any contract disputes. Preflight scheduled 2026-05-01 16:00 UTC.

miguel_billing: Timeline OK. Staging run by 2026-04-28, exceptions sheet by 2026-04-29, PR + dry-run by 2026-04-30.

leo_finance: Great. Thanks all  action owners, please update the rollout doc and add links to CSV/PRs.
